title: A derivative that is invertible everywhere
promptMarkdown: Analyse $F(x,y)=(e^x\cos y,e^x\sin y)$. Prove that it is a local diffeomorphism and determine its image and every fibre. Construct a smooth inverse on a suitable open subset of its image, with its domain in the source specified. Does it give a global diffeomorphism?
hintLadder: Compute the determinant before using the inverse theorem.
Recover $e^x$ from radius; the angular coordinate is only defined modulo $2\pi$.
Specify a branch cut and an interval of angles.
